notes.title: 1.6.7 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed an issue where the last(20th) score would not be cleared when resetting the local scoreboard.

notes.title: 1.6.6 Patch Note
notes.content: Fixed not being able to reset score with controller input in local scoreboard.

notes.title: 1.6.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] The maximum difficulty of Novice mode has been increased.

[*] You can now reset your score by pressing the key corresponding to the warp function on the local scoreboard.[/list]

notes.title: 1.6.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] The maximum number of mines that Avoider can place on the screen has been slightly reduced.

[*] Now Avoider will no longer appear in the first stage of Dogfight Mode.[/list]

notes.title: 1.6.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] You can now adjust the number of lives you begin with in increments of 1.

[*] Added 3 independent local highscore boards for each gamemode.[/list]

notes.title: 1.6.2 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Added local highscore board.

[*] Player's thrust speed has been slightly reduced.[/list]

notes.title: 1.6.1 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] Now the version number will be displayed on the title screen.

[*] Adjusted the difficulty of the Brawl Mode.[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.9 Patch Note
notes.content: Changed the 1979 Mode to 1980 Mode. In 1980 Mode, Magnet Missiles will appear.

notes.title: 1.5.8 Patch Note
notes.content: Reduced the difficulty of the Normal Mode.

notes.title: 1.5.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] The player's movement speed has been slightly reduced even more.

[*] The order of special levels is now always random on hard difficulty or higher.

[*] Increased the attack speed of the last remaining enemy fighter in Dogfight Mode.[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[list][*] The player's movement speed has been slightly reduced.

[*] The amount of points scored when catching a pilot in Dogfight mode has been increased from 400 points to 2000 points.

[*] Enemy fighters' shield durability has been decreased in Dogfight mode.[/list]

notes.title: 1.5.5 Patch Note
notes.content: You can set the dead zone for the controller analog stick in controls settings.

notes.title: 1.5.4 Patch Note
notes.content: A language change option has been added to the game.
